name: R
description: An isolated R workspace with exact native sessions and retained original output.

capabilities.title: r.session
capabilities.description: Observe this instance without starting R.

capabilities.title: r.prepare
capabilities.description: Freeze this native session before operation admission; no runtime starts.

capabilities.title: r.create_session
capabilities.description: Create one R session for this exact plugin instance.

capabilities.title: r.execute
capabilities.description: Execute in the admitted session and retain output with the original Operation.

capabilities.title: r.snapshot
capabilities.description: Observe bounded objects in an existing idle session.

capabilities.title: Answer R input
capabilities.description: Answer an existing native input request. Answers are transient; inspect r.session after a lost acknowledgement.

capabilities.title: R queue
capabilities.description: Observe queued original operations, pause and pending Host settlement without starting R.

capabilities.title: Pause R queue
capabilities.description: Pause the existing queue; the current run continues. Match the observed pause identity or null.

capabilities.title: Resume R queue
capabilities.description: Resume an observed pause after original Host settlements. Never confirms a scientific result or replays an operation.

capabilities.title: Execute R input with source
capabilities.description: Execute the supplied code, output mode and source labels in the exact admitted session. Labels do not attest to a Host document capture.

started.description: Always false when the owner confirms cancellation before native execution.

value.description: R's dynamic value; larger values remain in the full retained report.

capabilities.title: Check R code
capabilities.description: Check completeness in the existing idle session without evaluating code.

capabilities.title: Observe original R output
capabilities.description: Read bounded events while a run is active. Observations never establish terminal execution status.

capabilities.title: List R objects
capabilities.description: Read a bounded stable binding directory in the exact expected_session. Reading never starts R or evaluates active/lazy bindings.

object_type.description: Filter by native R typeof (for example double, character, list or closure); classes remain metadata.

output_schema.title: RInspection
output_schema.description:
A successful RPC can report a busy or unavailable native observation. No
cached value is presented as current, and continuation errors keep their code.

preview.description: A small native sample for immediate recognition, never a full profile.

table_features.description: Native reader features, separate from attributes stored on the R object.

color.description: Canonical R color when this complete character value is a valid color.

capabilities.title: Observe an R object
capabilities.description: Create a scoped read-only observation for progressive inspection in the exact expected_session.

capabilities.title: Read an R object observation
capabilities.description: Read bounded structure, values, children, table slices or text using the original object reference and exact expected_session.

slice.description: One-based coordinates for dimensions 3 and above; omitted coordinates select the first slice.

text_attribute.description: For kind=text, select "names" or "levels" instead of character values.

observed_path.description: Path fixed when the observation opened, separate from this read's relative path.

capabilities.title: Preview an R binding
capabilities.description: Read a bounded binding preview in the exact expected_session without forcing active/lazy bindings.

capabilities.title: Observe installed R packages
capabilities.description: Read package metadata in the exact expected_session. Grouped counts and copy details continue one observation; no package is installed, loaded, attached or tested.

input_schema.title: PackageQueryArguments
input_schema.description: Bounded observation of the libraries and namespaces of the existing R session.

output_schema.title: RInspection

cached value is presented as current, and continuation errors keep their code.

capabilities.title: Inspect an observed package copy
capabilities.description: Read the static index of the original observed package copy in the exact expected_session.

capabilities.title: Read observed R help
capabilities.description: Read bounded help text or HTML from the exact installed copy and file identities returned by r.package_index, in the exact expected_session.

HelpFormat.description:
Rendering format. HTML is produced by the static `tools::Rd2HTML` stage and is
suitable for a sanitized document view; text remains the bounded default.

A successful RPC can report a busy or unavailable native observation. No
cached value is presented as current, and continuation errors keep their code.

HelpFormat.description:
Rendering format. HTML is produced by the static `tools::Rd2HTML` stage and is
suitable for a sanitized document view; text remains the bounded default.

version.description: Present for HTML: the package version recorded in the observed copy.

capabilities.title: Observe R inspection readiness
capabilities.description: Observe this exact owner without starting R. Session-scoped cache keys change around native execution, including runs missed between polls, and never establish scientific results or preconditions.

expected_session.description: Null observes an unstarted instance; a supplied session must match exactly.

output_schema.title: RInspectionState
output_schema.description:
A cheap observation of this R owner's inspection readiness. The cache key is
scoped to the exact instance and session. It invalidates presentation caches,
never serves as a scientific precondition or establishes an Operation outcome.

cache_key.description:
Changes before and after native execution, even if polling misses the run.
Read-only inspections do not change it. None means no session exists.

capabilities.title: Format R code
capabilities.description: Format captured text in the exact existing session using an installed styler. Does not evaluate the text, install tooling or write a project file. The original retained report contains the complete FormatResult; value_in_report marks an oversized inline value.

input_schema.title: FormatRCode
input_schema.description:
An explicit code-tool Operation in an already selected native session.
Formatting parses text; it does not evaluate it or write a project file.

started.description: Always false when the owner confirms cancellation before native execution.

value.description: R's dynamic value; larger values remain in the full retained report.

capabilities.title: Create R with a realized Environment
capabilities.description: Create one session using an exact original Environment realization. Explicitly delegates native verification to the selected provider, preserves its original operation and report, then checks the new native R installation. Does not rebind an existing session or replay an unconfirmed creation.

target.description: Owner-defined native identity, fixed at admission. Not interpreted by core.

REnvironmentSelection.description:
Exact Environment provider and original successful realization. Selecting it
does not start R; creation performs explicit verification under this binding.

capabilities.title: Select Environment for a new R session
capabilities.description: Read and pin a verified original library through the exact selected Environment provider. Never starts R or tests namespace loading.
